topic: Unit 3: Extended Writing - Film and Literature
subject: french

items.q: What is the most common informal way to form a yes/no question in French?
items.correct: Rising intonation (statement said as a question) or using 'est-ce que'.
items.why: Students learn formal inversion first. In conversation, French uses intonation or est-ce que far more often. Inversion sounds formal/written - 'Tu parles français?' is the everyday form.
Sensible is a faux ami. French 'sensible' = sensitive/easily affected. English 'sensible' = raisonnable in French. Confusion leads to wrong impressions of someone's character.
Students use 'ends in -e = feminine' as a rule. Many exceptions exist: le problème, le système, le programme, le poème - all masculine despite the -e ending. Gender must often be memorised.
